faucets.name: AAVE Staging Faucet
faucets.notes: Connect a wallet on app.aave.com, switch to a testnet (Sepolia), and use the Faucet section to mint test AAVE and other assets. Replaces the retired staging.aave.com faucet. (The site is behind bot protection, so our HTTP check may show degraded even though it works in a browser.)

faucets.name: Polypore Faucet
faucets.notes: No captcha. Switched from theta to provider testnet.

faucets.name: Cardano Preprod Faucet
faucets.notes: Select Preprod Testnet from dropdown. Explorer: https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/

faucets.name: BNB Smart Chain Faucet
faucets.notes: Heads up — this faucet is gated: your address must already hold >= 0.002 BNB on BNB Smart Chain MAINNET to claim (anti-abuse check), so a fresh empty wallet can't use it. Only Smart Chain (0x...) addresses are accepted; forward to Beacon Chain (tbnb...) via Binance Wallet if needed.

faucets.name: mainnet.cash BCH Faucet
faucets.notes: Keyless, no captcha or login: POST your bchtest: address to /faucet/get_testnet_bch. Up to 10,000 sats (0.0001 tBCH) per call; won't top up if you already hold >=10k sats. Part of the actively-maintained mainnet.cash project.

faucets.name: BitcoinFaucet UO1
faucets.notes: Does not work with SegWit addresses.

faucets.name: CoinFaucet BTC Testnet
faucets.notes: Alternative when bitcoinfaucet.uo1.net fails. Does not work with SegWit.

faucets.name: DevWork BTC Testnet Faucet
faucets.notes: Third BTC option when the other two are dry or rate-limited. Has a browser verification step (Cloudflare/captcha-style). Sourced from faucet-list.com.

faucets.name: Polkadot Westend Faucet
faucets.notes: Web faucet: paste your Westend address, solve the captcha, Submit. 100 WND per request, once per 24h. Add ?parachain=1000 to fund an Asset Hub address. The old #westend_faucet Matrix room is dead — ignore it.

faucets.name: Google Cloud Sepolia Faucet
faucets.notes: Lowest-friction Sepolia faucet: no mainnet-balance requirement. Sign in with any Google account, paste your 0x address, claim (~0.05 ETH/day). Replaces the retired sepoliafaucet.io. Backup with no login: pk910 PoW faucet at https://sepolia-faucet.pk910.de/ (mine in-browser, hCaptcha). Avoid Alchemy's faucet — it now requires mainnet ETH + activity.

faucets.name: pk910 Sepolia PoW Faucet
faucets.notes: Proof-of-work faucet: no login and no mainnet balance needed. Mine in-browser (hCaptcha), then claim to your address — the longer you mine, the more ETH. A solid backup to the Google Cloud faucet.

faucets.name: SolFaucet
faucets.notes: Click Testnet tab. Alternatives: Triangle, QuickNode airdrop.

faucets.name: Lora Algorand Testnet Faucet
faucets.notes: Quick email registration (just email validation). Request ALGO from the Fund page. Replaces the dead AlgoExplorer dispenser.

faucets.name: Stellar Friendbot
faucets.notes: This is an API, not a web page — opening the bare URL shows a 'Bad Request' JSON response, which is normal. To fund an account, append ?addr=<your-address> to the URL. Alternatives: Freighter wallet built-in faucet, Stellar Lab account funder, Demo Wallet (10,000 XLM).

faucets.name: Circle Faucet
faucets.notes: 10 USDC/EURC every 24h. If XLM daily limit exceeded, swap XLM->USDC via Freighter on Testnet.

faucets.name: Core Avalanche Fuji Faucet
faucets.notes: Up to 2 AVAX per claim, 24h cooldown. Replaces the dead Covalent faucet. Gated: the address must hold >0 AVAX on Avalanche mainnet. Empty wallet? Get a coupon from https://guild.xyz/avalanche or the Avalanche Discord and enter it on the faucet. faucet.avax.network redirects here.

faucets.name: Flow Testnet Faucet
faucets.notes: 1000 FLOW per request. Moved here from testnet-faucet.onflow.org.

faucets.name: Polygon Faucet
faucets.notes: Polygon Amoy faucet. MATIC is the legacy token name — Amoy now runs on POL, so most testing uses the POL claim flow instead. This higher-drip path requires connecting Discord. See also the POL faucet entry for the no-Discord claim.

faucets.name: Fantom Faucet
faucets.notes: Fantom's testnet is deprecated — the network rebranded to Sonic (see the Sonic Testnet entry). There is no working public Fantom testnet faucet; for the successor network get test S at testnet.soniclabs.com, docs at docs.soniclabs.com.

faucets.name: Sonic Testnet Faucet
faucets.notes: The network Fantom rebranded to. Connect a Web3 wallet (add Sonic Testnet, chainId 14601), solve the captcha, and request from the dashboard (~5 S per claim, ~1h cooldown — approximate). Docs: docs.soniclabs.com. Note: the old Sonic 'Blaze' testnet (chainId 57054) is retired — use 14601.

faucets.name: Core Testnet Faucet
faucets.notes: Mainnet swap CORE<->USDT-CORE at https://app.corex.network/

faucets.name: Sui Testnet Faucet
faucets.notes: Official web faucet — pick Testnet from the network dropdown, paste your address, and request. Also obtainable via the Sui Discord.

faucets.name: Hedera Portal
faucets.notes: Requires Hedera Portal account.

faucets.name: Dash CrowdNode Faucet
faucets.notes: HTTP only (no TLS).

faucets.name: Hiro Stacks Sandbox Faucet
faucets.notes: Connect a Stacks wallet (Leather or Xverse), confirm the network toggle is on Testnet, open the Faucet tab, and click Request STX (500 tSTX). The old api.testnet.hiro.so endpoint is dead — the API host moved to api.hiro.so.

faucets.name: Faucy
faucets.notes: Connect supported wallet (e.g. Subwallet). 0.5 tVFY per claim.

faucets.name: Polygon Amoy Faucet
faucets.notes: Polygon Amoy faucet, POL claim flow: paste your address and click CLAIM — 0.01 POL per claim, no Discord needed (unlike the legacy MATIC path). POL is the current Polygon token that replaced MATIC.

faucets.name: Aptos Testnet Faucet
faucets.notes: Requires Google account.

faucets.name: NEAR Testnet Faucet
faucets.notes: Paste your testnet account/address and request — 2 NEAR per claim, no login or captcha. Community faucet (near-faucet.io).

faucets.name: Provenance Testnet (via Discord)
faucets.notes: No confirmed public web faucet. The old explorer.test.provenance.io has reached end of life; the new explorer is Zonescan (https://zonescan.io). Request testnet HASH via the Provenance Discord — see the developer portal for the current channel.

faucets.name: Kaia Kairos Faucet
faucets.notes: 50 KAIA or 10 test USDT per claim, 24h cooldown. Paste an address — no wallet connect needed. Also lists a Nodit-powered alternative for bulk requests.

faucets.name: CypherFaucet Litecoin Testnet
faucets.notes: 0.01 tLTC per claim, once per hour (per address and per IP). Also has a keyless API (POST /api/v1/claim). Established 2025, live balance shown on-page. Replaces the bot-blocked bitaps faucet.

faucets.name: Coinbase Base Sepolia Faucet
faucets.notes: Free Coinbase Developer Platform account, but no mainnet balance needed — the least-gated Base option. Also drips test USDC/EURC/cbBTC. Alchemy/QuickNode Base faucets instead require ~0.001 ETH on Ethereum mainnet.

faucets.name: L2Faucet Arbitrum Sepolia
faucets.notes: Ungated: device attestation via a browser passkey (WebAuthn) or the Automata app — no login, wallet, or mainnet balance. Dispenses ETH on Arbitrum Sepolia. Backup: Alchemy (needs 0.001 mainnet ETH) or bridge Sepolia ETH via the Arbitrum bridge.

faucets.name: Optimism Superchain Faucet
faucets.notes: GitHub login + on-chain reputation (Optimist NFT / Gitcoin Passport / World ID raise the drip up to 1 ETH). Covers Base/OP/Zora Sepolia. Least-gated backup: L2Faucet (l2faucet.com/optimism, device attestation, no login).

faucets.name: L2Faucet Scroll Sepolia
faucets.notes: Ungated device attestation (passkey) — no login/wallet/mainnet. Dispenses ETH on Scroll Sepolia. Official alternative: the Scroll Telegram faucet bot ('/drop <address>', see docs.scroll.io), or bridge Sepolia ETH via the Scroll bridge.

faucets.name: thirdweb Linea Sepolia Faucet
faucets.notes: The official faucet.linea.build is currently offline (DNS dead). This thirdweb faucet works with a connected wallet. Alternatives: HackQuest (hackquest.io/faucets/59141), ETHGlobal's Linea faucet (login, no mainnet balance), or bridge Sepolia ETH via the Linea bridge.

faucets.name: Celo Alfajores Faucet
faucets.notes: Captcha only — no login or mainnet balance, the least-gated of these six. Optional GitHub login gives ~10x more (up to ~5 CELO). Also drips cUSD/cEUR/cREAL.

faucets.name: Hyperliquid Testnet Drip
faucets.notes: The official faucet, for trading on Hyperliquid testnet rather than for HyperEVM gas. Gated: the same address must already have deposited on Hyperliquid MAINNET, so a fresh wallet cannot claim — a small USDC deposit over the Arbitrum bridge satisfies it. If you sign in by email, Privy issues a different wallet on testnet, so export the mainnet key into MetaMask or Rabby first. For HyperEVM gas (chain 998) use the Chainstack or thirdweb faucets instead.

faucets.name: Chainstack HyperEVM Faucet
faucets.notes: The largest HyperEVM drip of the three and the only one with no mainnet gate. Needs a free Chainstack account: sign in to the console, copy an API key from Settings, then paste your address on the faucet page. No wallet connection and no Twitter task.

faucets.name: thirdweb HyperEVM Faucet
faucets.notes: Smallest drip, but the lowest friction if you already use thirdweb — connect a wallet (EOA or social login), one claim per chain per 24h. The faucet widget lives on the chain page; /faucet redirects here. Enough for gas, not for anything else.
